skills.description: Read-only Oracle SQL and live schema export for SimpleERP. Runs npm run setup (export DDL + regenerate references) then SELECT/WITH/EXPLAIN PLAN via scripts/run-sql.mjs. Use when the user asks about SimpleERP database tables, columns, joins, row counts, or ad-hoc SQL reports. Requires credentials
skills.description_zh: 只读 Oracle SQL，实时导出 SimpleERP schema。运行 npm run setup（导出 DDL 并重新生成引用），随后通过 scripts/run-sql.mjs 执行 SELECT/WITH/EXPLAIN PLAN。当用户询问 SimpleERP 数据库表、字段、关联、行数或临时 SQL 报表时使用。需提供凭证。
skills.name: Simpleerp DB
